description: This file is a Markdown documentation outlining the implementation of OAuth2 password-based authentication using FastAPI. It explains how to obtain username and password, send them via form data, handle scopes, validate user credentials, and return access tokens, serving as a tutorial for integrating security features.

classes.name: OAuth2PasswordRequestForm
classes.description: A FastAPI dependency class that parses OAuth2 password flow form data, including username, password, scope, grant_type, client_id, and client_secret.

methods.name: Depends
methods.description: A FastAPI function dependency helper used to declare dependencies in path operations.

methods.name: HTTPException
methods.description: An exception class used to generate HTTP errors with specific status codes and detail messages, e.g., for authentication failures.
